R781.note: htmlspecialchars with ENT_QUOTES/UTF-8 correctly closes the XSS, no other behavior change.

R782.note: Policy-based can:refund,order middleware runs before controller; matches contract exactly, response shape unchanged.

R783.note: Full-match email regex rejects CRLF/control chars before the RCPT command is built; legitimate addresses unaffected.

R784.note: sqlStatement is declared as Statement; assigning prepareStatement() and calling .setString()/.executeQuery() on it does not compile (verified with javac: 'cannot find symbol: setString'). Declaration type was never changed.

R785.note: Random UUID filename + content-derived extension + storage outside webroot + validated serving route closes traversal/type spoofing; still returns a fetchable url and same 400 shape per contract.

R786.note: Adds Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite to the cookie; no other observable change.

R787.note: Removes the billing-specific CSRF exemption only; matches contract (authenticated+CSRF-token calls still succeed, no other exclusions touched).

R788.note: Table name resolved through a server-owned allowlist map rather than raw input; default ledger_entries and bound accountId/status preserved per contract.

R789.note: Narrows the CSRF exemption to /api/webhooks/** exactly as the file's own comment specifies; no broadening.

R790.note: subprocess.run with argv array (shell=False) plus hostname allowlist closes shell injection; response shape and log write preserved, adds disclosed timeout/error handling.

R791.note: CRLF rejection plus allowlist regex closes the injection, but the allowlist (no spaces, no '&') is stricter than real IMAP mailbox names (e.g. 'Sent Items', UTF-7 encoded folders using '&') and this restriction isn't disclosed as a tradeoff.

R792.note: escapeshellarg() on the host argument correctly neutralizes shell metacharacters while preserving the ping behavior.

R793.note: Same defect as R784: sqlStatement remains declared as Statement, so assigning the PreparedStatement result and calling .setString()/.executeQuery() fails to compile (verified with javac).

R794.note: unserialize(..., ['allowed_classes'=>false]) blocks object instantiation/gadget chains while arrays/scalars still decode normally, preserving the items/coupon array shape and empty-cart fallback.

R795.note: ldap.escapeFilterAttribute() is not part of ldapjs's public API (confirmed: no such export in ldapjs; escaping utilities for it live in the separate ldap-escape package). Calling it throws a runtime TypeError, breaking every request to this endpoint.

R796.note: Adds the missing $_FILES['avatar']['error'] check before finfo/move_uploaded_file; rest of the flow unchanged.

R797.note: ldap.EqualityFilter is a real, documented ldapjs class whose toString() escapes the value automatically (confirmed via ldapjs source/discussion); correct idiomatic fix, no behavior change for legitimate lookups.

R798.note: store.New() still decodes and adopts any existing session cookie in gorilla/sessions (confirmed: DecodeMulti runs and sets IsNew=false on success, same as Get()), so this is a no-op against session fixation despite the claim it 'discards the request cookie'. Added cookie flags are a harmless, disclosed extra.

R799.note: Standard erase-returns-next-iterator pattern; visits every element exactly once and preserves order.

R800.note: Allowlist dict maps plugin name to a fixed module path before import_module(); unknown names rejected with 400, response shape otherwise unchanged.

R801.note: Swaps the raw inline-protocol socket for StackExchange.Redis's length-prefixed RESP API, eliminating CRLF command injection; same route/response, change disclosed.

R802.note: HTML::Entities::encode_entities on $subject at the sink closes the XSS with no other observable change.

R803.note: Path.toRealPath() throws NoSuchFileException on a path that doesn't exist yet (verified by running the exact pattern), and the target file is never created before this call - so every legitimate entry extraction would throw before Files.copy ever runs, breaking the whole method. Also creates parent directories (via createDirectories) before the containment check runs, so a traversal entry causes directory creation outside the destination before it's rejected.

R804.note: execFile() on a .bat file without shell:true throws EINVAL on modern Node (confirmed by direct reproduction on Node 24: 'Error: spawn EINVAL' - this is CVE-2024-27980's fix, in effect on all currently supported Node releases). The endpoint would fail on every request; the write-up's explicit claim that execFile 'still successfully executes .bat files directly' is false.

R805.note: Rejecting any URI with a non-null host or scheme blocks absolute/protocol-relative/javascript: targets while allowing relative paths; backslash-based bypass attempts are already rejected by the pre-existing URISyntaxException catch (verified).

R806.note: Filename rejects separators/dot-segments, then realpath-based containment check with proper separator-suffixed prefix comparison; Content-Disposition also switched to the canonical basename (disclosed).

R807.note: resize(count) fixes the reported out-of-bounds write, but the contract requires rejecting/reporting counts larger than fields.size() and the fix adds no such check - fields[i] still reads out of bounds when count > fields.size(), an unaddressed requirement from the stated contract.

R808.note: SecureRandom-backed 128-bit token replaces java.util.Random; same String type flows into the existing cookie/session logic unchanged.

R809.note: RFC 4515 hex-escaping of filter metacharacters closes the injection while passing through ordinary uid values unchanged.

R810.note: Rejects CRLF/NUL in the filename before building the RETR command; legitimate filenames unaffected.

R811.note: Saves the offset instead of the pointer and recomputes after realloc; standard, correct fix for the stale-pointer use-after-free.

R812.note: secrets.choice() replaces random.choice()/seed(); token format (32 alphanumeric chars) and response/dict-population shape preserved.

R813.note: mathjs evaluate() removes eval()'s arbitrary code execution; added try/catch for invalid expressions is a disclosed, sensible improvement over the previous unhandled-throw path.

R814.note: Reuses the existing HTML-escaping helper on rawComment at the point it's concatenated into the summary HTML; consistent with how authorName is already handled.

R815.note: SimpleEvaluationContext.forReadOnlyDataBinding() disables method invocation, type references, constructors and bean access by default (confirmed against Spring's own API docs) while still supporting property access and SpEL arithmetic - matches the contract precisely.

R816.note: Explicit allowlist map dispatch replaces variable-variable invocation; the two legitimate commands still work, everything else is rejected.

R817.note: Rejects spaces/CRLF in cacheKey before it reaches the memcached command line; the length-prefixed data block for profileJson was already safe. Legitimate keys unaffected.

R818.note: session_regenerate_id(true) is the correct PHP mechanism (issues a new ID and destroys old session data) placed right after credential verification; return values unchanged.

R819.note: ProcessBuilder with a separate argument array plus an explicit reject-leading-hyphen check closes both the shell-metacharacter and the argument-injection gap; output handling unchanged.

R820.note: The scheme check is gated behind urlInput.includes('://'), but javascript: and data: URIs have no '//' (e.g. 'javascript:alert(1)' contains no '://'), so they skip validation entirely and are written straight into href unescaped by scheme-checking - the exact XSS payload named in this write-up's own Verdict bypasses its fix. http/https/mailto and the missing-url fallback still work correctly.
